title: A FIRST BLOTTER DOSE DRAWS THE MELT ONCE
why: Found by the review of 2026-10-07: the v18.93 crossfade, which blends the old melt into the new one when another dose is taken, also ran on the first dose, when there was nothing showing to fade out of, so for 8 seconds the melt pass was drawn twice over the whole screen at 4K for no visible gain. It now runs only when a trip was actually showing.
now: Taking a first Blotter dose costs less drawing for its first seconds.
